Package vaultWeb.security.pat

Class PatTokens

java.lang.Object
vaultWeb.security.pat.PatTokens
public final class PatTokens extends Object
Format helpers for personal access tokens.

Format: vw_pat_<publicId>_<secret> where publicId is 12 base62 characters (non-secret lookup id) and secret is 32 bytes from SecureRandom, base64url encoded without padding (43 characters).
